categories.sourceOrGeneration: Create or export representative PDFs from Acrobat Pro, including plain text, edited text, page organization, comments, and simple forms.
categories.licensePrivacy: Local test documents only; do not commit proprietary or customer PDFs.
categories.storagePolicy: Store private PDFs outside the repository and record only an anonymized path or acquisition note.
categories.expectedBehavior: Files open without repair prompts and survive export/reopen with page geometry and visible content intact.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Use Acrobat Pro to edit existing text, images, and annotations, then save incrementally and as optimized copies.
categories.storagePolicy: Prefer generated source documents committed as scripts; keep Acrobat outputs private when licensing is unclear.
categories.expectedBehavior: PDFeditor can open, render, edit, export, and validate Acrobat-edited PDFs without losing object structure.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Create signed PDFs with Acrobat self-signed and locally trusted certificates, including tampered variants.
categories.storagePolicy: Do not commit private keys. Commit only public sample certificates when license permits.
categories.expectedBehavior: Signatures are detected, validation status is explicit, and tampering invalidates byte integrity.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Collect or generate AcroForm text, checkbox, radio, combo, list, signature-field, and XFA detection fixtures.
categories.licensePrivacy: Use public/government forms only when redistribution is allowed; otherwise use manifest-only entries.
categories.storagePolicy: Do not commit forms containing personal data.
categories.expectedBehavior: AcroForm values and appearances survive export; XFA is detected and clearly marked unsupported.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Annotate synthetic PDFs in macOS Preview with highlights, notes, shapes, and ink.
categories.storagePolicy: Commit generation instructions; commit outputs only if fully synthetic.
categories.expectedBehavior: Preview-created annotations import, edit, delete, and flatten without hidden overlay-only output.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Use Chrome print-to-PDF for web pages with text, tables, links, and images.
categories.licensePrivacy: Use locally generated HTML fixtures or permissively licensed pages.
categories.storagePolicy: Commit local HTML generators rather than copyrighted print outputs when possible.
categories.expectedBehavior: Chrome-generated PDFs preserve searchable text, links, and page geometry after export.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Use Edge print-to-PDF for the same local HTML fixture set used by Chrome.
categories.storagePolicy: Commit generation steps; keep browser output reproducible.
categories.expectedBehavior: Edge-generated PDFs preserve searchable text, links, and page geometry after export.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Export Word documents covering headings, footers, tables, comments, and CJK text.
categories.storagePolicy: Commit DOCX generator or document when possible; otherwise record reproducible export steps.
categories.expectedBehavior: Text editing and reflow avoid tables and preserve searchable text after export.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Export Excel sheets with grid-heavy tables, page breaks, and mixed page sizes.
categories.storagePolicy: Commit generator or source spreadsheet when license permits.
categories.expectedBehavior: Rendering, crop/page boxes, and export validation remain stable.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Export slide decks with images, vector shapes, transparency, and embedded fonts.
categories.storagePolicy: Commit generator or source deck when possible.
categories.expectedBehavior: Image/vector object detection and preflight signals do not corrupt slide-like PDFs.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Use public forms or synthetic lookalikes covering contracts, invoices, tax, and bank-style layouts.
categories.licensePrivacy: Public-domain or synthetic only; no personal data.
categories.storagePolicy: Record URL and license for public forms; otherwise use synthetic generator.
categories.expectedBehavior: Forms, signatures, annotations, and export/reopen workflows are usable on business documents.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Generate scanned image-over-text and image-only PDFs in Korean and English with varied DPI.
categories.storagePolicy: Commit source images when generated; otherwise record generator inputs.
categories.expectedBehavior: OCR creates searchable text, correction persists, and image-over-text output remains visually intact.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Generate text PDFs with Korean, Japanese, Chinese, emoji, Arabic/Hebrew RTL, and mixed Latin content.
categories.storagePolicy: Commit generator and generated fixture if font licensing permits.
categories.expectedBehavior: Text remains searchable and visual fallback behavior is explicit for unsupported shaping cases.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Collect tagged PDFs, PDF/A claim files, PDF/X claim files, and accessibility samples.
categories.licensePrivacy: Use public validator samples or locally generated fixtures.
categories.storagePolicy: Record source URL/license; do not claim certification without validator evidence.
categories.expectedBehavior: Reports identify standard signals and limitations without overclaiming certification.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Generate or collect PDFs with embedded files, JS/actions, OCG, stale incremental saves, comments, RichMedia, and hidden search/index signals.
categories.licensePrivacy: Synthetic secrets only; never use real sensitive data.
categories.storagePolicy: Commit only fixtures with placeholder secrets and no executable external payloads.
categories.expectedBehavior: Sanitizer removes claimable hidden data and reports any unsupported hidden content clearly.

categories.sourceOrGeneration: Generate large 100/300/500/1000-page PDFs and add malformed-but-openable variants.
categories.storagePolicy: Generate under tmp/ for size; commit generators only.
categories.expectedBehavior: Viewer remains responsive, validators report clear errors, and recoverable files open/export.
